name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions: search runs whose outcome is already written down shrink to one line per call.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum keep probability for a search run to stay call by call: 1 minus Jev's probability that the text after it reports what its calls showed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the state of one Jev request (one search run).

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus question in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Error head in the replacement note
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a failed call's output kept in the note that replaces a search run; 0 keeps only 'error'.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint
baseUrl.description: Endpoint of another System One model, e.g. http://192.168.107.103:5810/v1/systemone for the self-hosted decider. Leave unset for TypeSafe Jev; a custom endpoint needs no API key.

maxConcurrentRequests.title: Maximum concurrent requests
maxConcurrentRequests.description: Requests in flight at once; 1 for the single-GPU decider, whose queue would otherwise push later requests past the host's 30 s fetch limit. 0 for no limit.

condenseUrl.title: Condenser endpoint
condenseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL (e.g. http://192.168.107.103:11500/v1/chat/completions). When set, episodes the decider keeps are replaced by a fact note from this model, and their full outputs are saved under .claude/fast-jev/. Empty: kept episodes stay verbatim.

condenseModel.title: Condenser model
condenseModel.description: Model name for the condenser endpoint.

condenseMinChars.title: Minimum characters to condense
condenseMinChars.description: Smallest kept episode (tool input and output characters) handed to the condenser.
